$comment: Shared pretest/posttest bank for the whole course (docs/training-modules-plan.md §A: taken once before content, once after; delta = learning gain). Grows as modules 2-9 are authored (INC-24/25) — now covers Modules 1-5's objectives; modules 6-9 (INC-25) still owed.

questions.prompt_fil: Bakit masasabing mas malawak ang tungkulin ng BHW sa ilalim ng UHC Act of 2019?
questions.prompt_en: Why is a BHW's role said to be wider under the UHC Act of 2019?

options.fil: Dahil mas marami nang pasyenteng dapat asikasuhin araw-araw
options.en: Because there are more patients to attend to each day

options.fil: Dahil ang direksyon ng UHC ay primary care at health promotion, kaya kasama na ang pagtuturo at pag-oorganisa
options.en: Because UHC's direction is primary care and health promotion, so teaching and organising are now included

options.fil: Dahil kailangan nang makatapos ng kolehiyo ang bawat BHW
options.en: Because every BHW must now finish college

options.fil: Dahil ang BHW na ang humahalili sa midwife sa barangay
options.en: Because the BHW now replaces the midwife in the barangay

questions.prompt_fil: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng HEPO, ang itinalagang papel ng BHW sa ilalim ng UHC?
questions.prompt_en: What does HEPO — the BHW's designated role under UHC — stand for?

options.fil: Health Emergency Preparedness Officer
options.en: Health Emergency Preparedness Officer

options.fil: Household Enumeration and Profiling Officer
options.en: Household Enumeration and Profiling Officer

options.fil: Health Education and Promotion Officer
options.en: Health Education and Promotion Officer

options.fil: Health Extension and Primary-care Officer
options.en: Health Extension and Primary-care Officer

questions.prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI isa sa tatlong tungkuling nakasaad sa RA 7883?
questions.prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the three roles named in RA 7883?

options.fil: Health Educator
options.en: Health Educator

options.fil: Community Organizer
options.en: Community Organizer

options.fil: Health Service Provider
options.en: Health Service Provider

options.fil: Barangay Treasurer for Health
options.en: Barangay Treasurer for Health

questions.prompt_fil: Tinipon ni BHW Marites ang mga nanay sa purok para ipaliwanag kung paano maiiwasan ang pagtatae ngayong tag-ulan. Anong tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan?
questions.prompt_en: BHW Marites gathers the mothers in the purok to explain how to avoid diarrhoea during the rainy season. Which role is she performing?

options.fil: Health Educator
options.en: Health Educator

options.fil: Community Organizer
options.en: Community Organizer

options.fil: Health Service Provider
options.en: Health Service Provider

options.fil: Wala sa tatlo — gawain ito ng midwife
options.en: None of the three — this is the midwife's work

questions.prompt_fil: Kinausap ni BHW Ramon ang purok leader at ang kagawad para magkaroon ng lingguhang paglilinis ng kanal. Anong tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan?
questions.prompt_en: BHW Ramon talks to the purok leader and the kagawad about setting up a weekly canal clean-up. Which role is he performing?

options.fil: Health Educator
options.en: Health Educator

options.fil: Community Organizer
options.en: Community Organizer

options.fil: Health Service Provider
options.en: Health Service Provider

options.fil: Wala sa tatlo — gawain ito ng sanitary inspector
options.en: None of the three — this is the sanitary inspector's work

questions.prompt_fil: Bilang bahagi ng primary care team, sino ang karaniwang unang nasasalubong ng pangangailangang pangkalusugan sa komunidad?
questions.prompt_en: As part of the primary care team, who is usually the first contact a health need in the community meets?

options.fil: Ang city o municipal health officer
options.en: The city or municipal health officer

options.fil: Ang BHW, bilang frontline sa barangay
options.en: The BHW, as the barangay's frontline

options.fil: Ang public health nurse
options.en: The public health nurse

options.fil: Ang punong barangay
options.en: The barangay captain

questions.prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI karaniwang talaang hawak ng isang BHW?
questions.prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the records a BHW usually keeps?

options.fil: Household profile ng mga kabahayan sa nasasakupan niya
options.en: The household profile of the households in their area

options.fil: Master list ng mga grupo sa komunidad (sanggol, buntis, nakatatanda)
options.en: The master list of community groups (infants, pregnant women, the elderly)

options.fil: Registry ng mga taong nabigyan ng serbisyo
options.en: The registry of people given a service

options.fil: Talaan ng badyet at gastusin ng barangay
options.en: The barangay's budget and expenditure ledger

questions.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamahusay na dahilan kung bakit kailangang tama at napapanahon ang household profile na hawak ng BHW?
questions.prompt_en: What is the best reason a BHW's household profile needs to be accurate and up to date?

options.fil: Dahil ito ang hinahanap tuwing may inspeksyon
options.en: Because it is what gets checked during inspections

options.fil: Dahil kailangan ito para makakuha ng honorarium
options.en: Because it is needed to receive the honorarium

options.fil: Dahil ang mga datos na ito ang gumagabay sa programang pangkalusugan kung saan pupunta at ano ang uunahin
options.en: Because these data guide health programmes on where to go and what to prioritise

options.fil: Dahil ipinapadala ito nang buo sa DOH central office
options.en: Because it is forwarded in full to the DOH central office

questions.prompt_fil: Bukod sa pagpapatupad ng plano, anong papel ang inaasahan sa BHW sa barangay planning team for health sa ilalim ng UHC at ng LIPH?
questions.prompt_en: Beyond carrying out plans, what part is a BHW expected to take in the barangay planning team for health under UHC and the LIPH?

options.fil: Lumahok at mag-ambag sa lokal na pagpaplanong pangkalusugan
options.en: To participate in and contribute to local health planning

options.fil: Aprubahan ang badyet ng barangay para sa kalusugan
options.en: To approve the barangay's health budget

options.fil: Pumirma sa mga resolusyon ng sangguniang barangay
options.en: To sign the barangay council's resolutions

options.fil: Palitan ang kagawad sa kalusugan kapag wala ito
options.en: To stand in for the health kagawad when absent

questions.prompt_fil: Nabalitaan ng isang residente na 'libre na ang konsulta' dahil sa UHC Act. Ano ang pinakatamang paliwanag dito?
questions.prompt_en: A resident heard that "consultations are free now" because of the UHC Act. What is the most accurate explanation?

options.fil: Libre na ang lahat ng gamot at ospital dahil sa UHC
options.en: All medicine and hospitalization are now free because of UHC

options.fil: Sinasakop na ng PhilHealth ang outpatient consultation, kaya walang dapat ikatakot na bayad sa health center
options.en: PhilHealth now covers outpatient consultation, so there's nothing to worry about regarding cost at the health center

options.fil: Hindi totoo iyon, walang binago ang UHC sa pagbabayad
options.en: That's not true, UHC changed nothing about payment

options.fil: Libre lang ito kung may PhilHealth card na dala
options.en: It's only free if you're carrying a PhilHealth card

questions.prompt_fil: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pagkakaroon ng "primary care provider" sa ilalim ng UHC?
questions.prompt_en: What does having a "primary care provider" mean under UHC?

options.fil: Bawat Pilipino ay may nakatalagang unang lalapitan para sa pangangailangang pangkalusugan
options.en: Every Filipino has an assigned first person or facility to approach for a health need

options.fil: Kailangang pumili ng pribadong doktor ang bawat pamilya
options.en: Every family must choose a private doctor

options.fil: Libre na ang lahat ng gamutan sa alinmang ospital
options.en: Treatment is now free at any hospital

options.fil: Ang midwife na lang ang tanging puwedeng lapitan
options.en: The midwife is now the only person allowed to be approached

questions.prompt_fil: Bakit hindi sapat na malaman lang ng BHW ang mga pagbabagong dulot ng UHC Act?
questions.prompt_en: Why isn't it enough for a BHW to just know the changes the UHC Act brings?

options.fil: Dahil kailangan ding matukoy ng BHW ang pagkakataong mapabuti pa ang pagpapatupad nito sa sariling barangay, at maipaabot ang mungkahi sa tamang tao
options.en: Because the BHW also needs to spot chances to improve how it's carried out in their own barangay, and get the suggestion to the right person

options.fil: Dahil kailangang ipasa sa health board ang lahat ng detalye ng batas
options.en: Because every detail of the law must be submitted to the health board

options.fil: Dahil hindi ito bahagi ng kanilang tungkulin
options.en: Because it isn't part of their duty

options.fil: Dahil ang midwife na lang ang dapat magpaliwanag nito
options.en: Because only the midwife should explain it

questions.prompt_fil: Bakit ipinagbabawal ang pagtanggap ng regalo mula sa isang kumpanya ng gatas o gamot kapalit ng pag-promote?
questions.prompt_en: Why is it prohibited to accept a gift from a milk or medicine company in exchange for promotion?

options.fil: Dahil bawal talaga ang anumang regalo sa BHW anuman ang dahilan
options.en: Because BHWs are never allowed to accept any gift, for any reason

options.fil: Dahil maaaring maimpluwensyahan nito ang tamang serbisyo o payo na dapat matanggap ng mga tao sa health facility
options.en: Because it could influence the proper service or advice people should receive at the health facility

options.fil: Dahil kailangan munang mag-apply ng permit bago tumanggap ng regalo
options.en: Because a permit must first be applied for before accepting a gift

options.fil: Dahil bawal lang ito sa mga BHW na bago pa sa serbisyo
options.en: Because it's only prohibited for BHWs who are new to the service

questions.prompt_fil: Ano ang inaatas ng RA 10028 sa isang barangay health station, kaiba sa pagbabawal ng Milk Code?
questions.prompt_en: What does RA 10028 require of a barangay health station, unlike the Milk Code's prohibition?

options.fil: Aktibong isulong ang breastfeeding at magkaroon ng lactation station
options.en: Actively promote breastfeeding and have a lactation station

options.fil: Ihinto ang paggamit ng single-use plastics
options.en: Stop using single-use plastics

options.fil: Ibawal ang pagpasok ng kinatawan ng kumpanya ng gamot
options.en: Ban company representatives from entering

options.fil: Magtayo ng bagong gusali para sa BHS
options.en: Build a new BHS building

questions.prompt_fil: Sino ang nagbibigay ng akreditasyon sa isang BHW bago siya opisyal na makapagsimula sa gawain?
questions.prompt_en: Who accredits a BHW before they can officially begin their work?

options.fil: Ang midwife na kasama niya sa RHU
options.en: The midwife they work alongside at the RHU

options.fil: Ang local health board sa ilalim ng RA 7883
options.en: The local health board, under RA 7883

options.fil: Ang kapwa BHW na nagturo sa kanya
options.en: The fellow BHW who trained them

options.fil: Ang punong barangay
options.en: The punong barangay

questions.prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI kailangan para maging eligible sa BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service?
questions.prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT required for BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service?

options.fil: Akreditado ng local health board
options.en: Accredited by the local health board

options.fil: Limang taon o higit pa ng tuloy-tuloy na boluntaryong serbisyo
options.en: Five years or more of continuous voluntary service

options.fil: Nakatapos ng four-year college degree
options.en: Completed a four-year college degree

options.fil: May satisfactory service bilang accredited BHW
options.en: A satisfactory service record as an accredited BHW

questions.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamahusay na hakbang kapag mabagal ang proseso ng akreditasyon o naantala ang isang benepisyong dapat matanggap?
questions.prompt_en: What is the best move when the accreditation process is slow, or a benefit that's owed is delayed?

options.fil: Manahimik na lang hanggang matapos ito
options.en: Stay silent until it's over

options.fil: Mag-follow-up nang kalmado at may tiyak na tanong tungkol sa status
options.en: Follow up calmly with a specific question about the status

options.fil: Agad magreklamo sa mayor nang hindi muna dumadaan sa local health board
options.en: Immediately complain to the mayor without going through the local health board first

options.fil: Ituloy na lang ang gawain nang wala nang akreditasyon
options.en: Just continue working without the accreditation

questions.prompt_fil: May residenteng may matagal nang ubo at gustong malaman kung dapat bang i-refer. Sino ang unang lalapitan ng BHW para dito?
questions.prompt_en: A resident has had a long-standing cough and wants to know if it needs a referral. Who should the BHW approach first for this?

options.fil: Ang barangay captain
options.en: The barangay captain

options.fil: Ang midwife o RHU
options.en: The midwife or RHU

options.fil: Ang kapwa BHW
options.en: A fellow BHW

options.fil: Ang sanitary inspector
options.en: The sanitary inspector

questions.prompt_fil: Sa isang koponan ng mga BHW, ano ang pinakaunang dapat gawin kapag may personal na isyu ang isang miyembro na maaaring makaapekto sa gawain ng grupo?
questions.prompt_en: In a team of BHWs, what should be the very first response when a member has a personal issue that might affect the group's work?

options.fil: Balewalain ito hangga't hindi pa nakakaapekto sa trabaho
options.en: Ignore it as long as it hasn't affected work yet

options.fil: Agad itong pag-usapan bilang koponan bago pa ito lumalim
options.en: Talk about it as a team right away, before it deepens

options.fil: Iulat agad ito sa midwife nang hindi muna kinakausap ang miyembro
options.en: Report it straight to the midwife without talking to the member first

options.fil: Hintayin na lamang na lumipas ito
options.en: Just wait for it to pass

questions.prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI isa sa anim na kasanayan sa self-management na dapat taglayin ng isang BHW?
questions.prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the six self-management skills a BHW should have?

options.fil: Stress management
options.en: Stress management

options.fil: Time management
options.en: Time management

options.fil: Pagiging pinaka-magaling sa lahat ng BHW
options.en: Being the single best-performing BHW of all

options.fil: Adaptability
